run_stretch_client_capture: run a StretchClient to capture an image from the robot head camera
run_fastsam_segmentation: run FastSAM model inference on an image with retina masks and configurable confidence threshold
run_everything_prompt: run an everything prompt on FastSAMPrompt to segment all objects in an image
run_box_prompt: run a box prompt on FastSAMPrompt to segment objects within a specified bounding box region
run_plot_annotations: run plot on FastSAMPrompt to save annotated segmentation results to an output image file
